userStories.title: Validate — AGENTS.md runtime behavior via live LLM call

acceptanceCriteria: Use agent-browser to: login, navigate to Assistants page, create a new agent named 'Pirate Test Agent'

Save the agent
Switch to the Preview tab, send a message: 'Hello, how are you today?'
Wait for the LLM response and capture a screenshot
Verify the response contains pirate-like language (arr, matey, ahoy, ye, or similar pirate vocabulary)
If the response does NOT contain pirate language, add debug logging to backend/src/agents/__init__.py construct_agent() to log the final system_prompt content and length BEFORE passing to Orchestra
If debug logging reveals system_prompt is correct but LLM ignores it, document the finding — the issue is in deepagents/LLM behavior, not Orchestra code
Take screenshots of: the agent form, the AGENTS.md content, the chat response
Clean up: delete the test agent after verification
userStories.notes: The deepagents library confirmed: system_prompt is prepended to BASE_AGENT_PROMPT (line 193 of create_deep_agent). So the instructions SHOULD reach the LLM. This test validates the full runtime chain.
